comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap, remove it, tip out the battery, and restore the flashlight; candidate unlocks, adjusts, and relocks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use bimanual counterholding and repeated rotation, but flashlight disassembly adds axial thread following and pouring while lacking tool insertion, calibration, bounded relocking torque, and dynamic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Requires cap removal, battery deposited in a bin, and flashlight set down; candidate requires safe repeated carriage stops and post-lock drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Rotary loosening alone is insufficient overlap; the objective and measured terminal behavior are materially different.
